A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CLD research work. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–F are readable and support comparison after matching relocated content.

before.justification: v1 reports original coreset and transfer experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-1k, ablations, and CIFAR-10 attribution and prediction-brittleness experiments in Appendix F.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 2–6 and the appendix experiments.

M1.justification: Section 4.1 and Algorithm 1 retain the same loss-difference trajectories, class-specific validation averages, Pearson correlations, and per-class top-k selection. Added logging explanations do not establish a changed procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate coresets on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-1k and attribution on CIFAR-10. Contrastive learning, object detection, and language-model fine-tuning appear only as prospective applications or caveats in v2.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 2–5 and Appendix F, including the TracIn, TRAK, Arnoldi, Infl, and Datamodels comparisons. Newly cited language-model work is not evaluated as a baseline.

E3.justification: The classwise 10%/1% validation holdouts, model configurations, 164/90-epoch training recipes, metrics, and attribution-testing procedures remain unchanged. Logging clarifications do not revise the reported experimental settings.

E4.justification: Checkpoint subsampling, CCS-style stratification, validation-composition sensitivity, Appendix D stability/subset-size analyses, and Appendix F sample-removal studies are retained. The new discussion introduces no additional ablation or robustness experiment.

E5.justification: Both retain five-run mean and standard-deviation reporting for the coreset experiments, ten-seed LDS evaluation, and five retrainings for prediction brittleness. No new uncertainty-estimation procedure or significance test is introduced.

E6.justification: Matched tables and plots retain their results. For example, 10% CLD coresets still score 35.81 ± 0.21 on CIFAR-100 and 53.81 ± 0.23 on ImageNet-1k. Figure 2's added full-data accuracies, 70.95 and 69.91, repeat existing table values.

T1.justification: The assumptions, theorem, corollary, lemmas, and full proofs remain unchanged; added proof outlines restate existing arguments. However, new Appendix B.1 says validation error δ 'decays as O(sqrt(Q))', introducing a non-equivalent rate statement inconsistent with the retained O(B/sqrt(Q)) in Assumption 3.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about CLD selection, convergence guarantees, competitive accuracy, architectural transfer, checkpoint stability, and bias reduction. Expanded introductory explanations do not redefine these contributions.

C2.justification: Section 8 adds a rationale for loss differences over raw losses or gradient norms and explicitly limits empirical support to image classification. It also explains how divergent training and validation trajectories during language-model fine-tuning could undermine CLD, motivating different generalization proxies.

D1.justification: v2 adds a direct code-repository link on page 1. New logging notes reiterate the implementation already described in v1's Appendix E.4; hyperparameters, hardware, and training details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds Ren and Sutherland's LLM fine-tuning work and Xia et al.'s LESS paper to support its new applicability caveats. Existing coreset positioning and related-work coverage are otherwise retained.

P1.justification: Localized expansions clarify efficiency and transfer, add two discussion passages, and introduce Appendix B.1's roadmap and notation summary plus individual proof outlines. The overall narrative structure remains intact, with additional publication and acknowledgement edits.

P2.justification: v2 adds publication headers, relocates Figure 1 and Table 1, and places Figures 4 and 5 together. Figure 6's legends are enlarged and rearranged, and Figure 2's caption gains existing full-data reference values. No figures or tables are added or removed.

improvement.justification: The explicit applicability caveats, proof roadmap, clearer legends, and direct code link modestly improve clarity and usability. Empirical evidence and full proofs remain unchanged. The new δ-rate error in Appendix B.1 is a localized drawback, but the correct rate remains in Assumption 3; the overall benefit is limited but positive.
